title: NHP Infrastructure
description: NHP protocol infrastructure metrics: NLB flows, knock latency, auth rates, CPU, ASG health, and alarms

panels.title: Healthy Targets (Server)
panels.description: Number of healthy NLB targets for the NHP server. Action: if 0, check server ASG instances and NLB target group health checks.

panels.title: Healthy Targets (AC)
panels.description: Number of healthy NLB targets for the Access Controller. Action: if 0, check AC ASG instances and NLB target group health checks.

panels.title: Server CPU %
panels.description: Average CPU utilization across NHP server ASG instances. Action: if sustained >80%, consider scaling up or investigating high-CPU processes.

panels.title: Active NLB Flows
panels.description: Total active TCP/UDP flows across both server and AC NLBs. Action: correlate spikes with traffic patterns or potential DDoS.

panels.title: Unhealthy Targets
panels.description: Count of unhealthy NLB targets across server and AC. Action: any value >0 requires immediate investigation of instance health and NLB target group.

panels.title: NLB Active Flows - Server
panels.description: Active TCP/UDP flow count on the NHP server NLB over time. Action: correlate with knock traffic and investigate unexpected drops to 0.

panels.title: NLB Active Flows - AC
panels.description: Active TCP/UDP flow count on the AC NLB over time. Action: correlate with QURL access patterns and investigate unexpected drops.

panels.title: NLB Processed Bytes
panels.description: Total bytes processed by server and AC NLBs. Action: use for capacity planning and detecting traffic anomalies.

panels.title: TCP Resets
panels.description: TCP reset counts from clients, targets, and the NLB itself. Action: high client resets may indicate connection issues; high target resets suggest backend problems.

panels.title: NLB Target Response Time
panels.description: End-to-end response time measured by the NLB for TCP/TLS listeners (HTTP endpoint on port 8888). UDP knock port (62206) not included. Action: p99 >1s warrants investigation of server processing latency.

panels.title: NLB Unhealthy Host Count
panels.description: Unhealthy target count over time for server and AC NLBs. Action: any sustained non-zero value requires investigation of instance health, security groups, and health check configuration.

panels.title: NLB New Flow Count
panels.description: Rate of new TCP/UDP flows established through server and AC NLBs. Action: sudden spikes may indicate traffic surges or scanning activity.

panels.title: NLB Consumed LCUs
panels.description: Load Balancer Capacity Units consumed by server and AC NLBs. Each LCU costs money. Action: track for cost optimization and capacity planning.

panels.title: NHP Knock Latency
panels.description: End-to-end NHP knock latency at p50/p95/p99/p999 percentiles. p999 is the primary SLI for tail latency. Action: p999 >1s indicates protocol or network issues requiring investigation.

panels.title: Knock Latency p999
panels.description: Current p999 (99.9th percentile) knock latency. This is the tail latency SLI. Action: green <400ms healthy, yellow 400-1000ms degraded, red >1000ms needs immediate attention.

panels.title: Auth Success / Failure Rate
panels.description: Authentication success and failure rates from the NHP server MetricsPublisher. Failures indicate bad tokens, expired access, or protocol errors. Action: rising failure rate suggests key rotation issues or attack.

panels.title: Auth Success Count
panels.description: Total successful authentications in the selected time range. Action: a sudden drop may indicate server issues or upstream auth provider problems.

panels.title: Auth Failure Count
panels.description: Total failed authentications in the selected time range. Action: spikes may indicate brute-force attempts or misconfigured clients.

panels.title: CPU Utilization
panels.description: CPU utilization for server and AC ASG instances over time. Action: sustained >80% (red) requires scaling or performance investigation.

panels.title: ASG Instance Count
panels.description: Number of in-service instances per ASG. Action: if count drops below desired capacity, check ASG activity and instance launch errors.

panels.title: Target Group Health
panels.description: Healthy host count in NLB target groups. Action: should match ASG desired capacity; mismatches indicate health check failures.

panels.title: Unhealthy Targets
panels.description: Unhealthy host count in NLB target groups. Action: any non-zero (red) value requires immediate investigation of instance health.

panels.title: Memory Utilization
panels.description: Memory usage percentage from CloudWatch Agent on server and AC instances. Action: >80% indicates memory pressure; check for leaks or increase instance size.

panels.title: AC Disk Usage %
panels.description: Root filesystem disk usage from CloudWatch Agent on AC instances. Action: >80% requires log rotation or disk cleanup; >90% is critical.

panels.title: Disk Utilization
panels.description: Root filesystem disk usage from CloudWatch Agent on server instances. Action: >80% requires cleanup (Docker images, logs); >90% is critical.

panels.title: DynamoDB Throttled Requests
panels.description: Throttled read/write requests by DynamoDB table. Action: non-zero values indicate capacity limits being hit; consider increasing provisioned capacity or switching to on-demand.

panels.title: DynamoDB Latency (p50/p99)
panels.description: Successful request latency for DynamoDB tables at p50 and p99 percentiles. Action: p99 >20ms may indicate hot partitions or throttling.

panels.title: Active CloudWatch Alarms
panels.description: Table of all NHP CloudWatch alarms and their current state. Action: any alarm in ALARM state should be investigated immediately; check the alarm's linked metric for details.
